container: background-color: #0f1420; padding: 36px 12px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
card: background-color: #1b2438; border: 1px solid #39456b; border-top: 2px solid #39d0d8; border-radius: 10px; padding: 24px 20px; margin: 0 0 32px
h3: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #c9d2e3; margin: 26px 0 12px; padding-left: 10px; border-left: 3px solid #ff4ba3
blockquote: background-color: #10182a; border-left: 2px solid #39d0d8; padding: 14px 18px; margin: 0 0 16px; color: #7a869e; font-size: 14.5px
pre: background-color: #0a0e18; border: 1px solid #39456b; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; font-size: 13px; margin: 0 0 18px; line-height: 1.6
inline_code: background-color: #39456b; color: #c9d2e3; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 3px; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0
th: background-color: #0a0e18; color: #39d0d8; border: 1px solid #445280; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: 14px
